test_title: PYST 14: Selection Post (Graduation Level) - Reasoning (Held On 26 Jun, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question: In a certain code language, ‘MOBILES’ is written as ‘N12Y18O22H’ and ‘VEHICLE’ is written as ‘E22S18X15V’. How will ‘NEUTRON’ be written in the same code language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1e0988e9f2c88a4dbf6bbbce6382ec1889b72fd9c22241e90899754da12f5ab2.png] 

The logic followed here is:

‘MOBILES’ is written as ‘N12Y18O22H’

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/241ed817241647fb7badc07232e80ac9c08bce777b56e37146b2dddec45d9097.png] 

‘VEHICLE’ is written as ‘E22S18X15V’.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d93449b81e7f180f2cd46c64c0486e5d9811bb42cd144766272d62d702edb831.png] 

Similarly, ‘**NEUTRON**’ will be written:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3ade93ede4c238a618d6781500e671d1f30643c6bc5b3fe48353d572afa7cdc5.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **M22F7I12M**".
